test_title: PYST 70: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row, facing north. D sits to the immediate left of B. C sits third to the left of B. E is an immediate neighbour of B. F sits to the immediate right of C. E sits to the immediate left of A. Who sits at the extreme right end of the line?
solution:
**Given:**

D sits to the immediate left of B.

C sits third to the left of B.

E is an immediate neighbour of B.

F sits to the immediate right of C.

E sits to the immediate left of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/568e62a56a2eb8f15ad162d3a4467607b880c7b0997654bc6082f2ac9fd0b283.png] 

 

The person sitting at the extreme right end is **A**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
